title: Optional stdio MCP server tools are missing at session start after 0.172.0
symptoms: An MCP server that has a cached tool list does not appear started when the session opens
The server only launches when the model first calls one of its tools
Startup-time checks or hooks that expect the MCP process to already be running fail
cause: Since 0.172.0, optional stdio MCP servers that have a cached tool list start lazily on their first tool call by default, instead of at session startup.
fix: Do not assume the server process is running before the first tool call. If a workflow needs the server up early, trigger a call to one of its tools first and confirm in /mcp that it started.
affected: Codex CLI 0.172.0 and later, for optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists
